The '''Tythe system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]].
